voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (Windows SAPI), rate 0, on the build PC

lines.text: This is LucentDock: a smart dock for Windows, built and verified in public.
Your taskbar shows your apps. It doesn't show what needs you now: the meeting in ten minutes, the battery dying, the limits you set for yourself.
lines.show: Your taskbar shows apps - not what needs you

lines.text: When a meeting reaches ten minutes away, the dock rearranges itself: the calendar comes forward, distractions step aside, and one click puts everything back.
lines.show: When a meeting nears, the dock rearranges itself

lines.text: Three styles, including liquid glass, where the dock's material is your own wallpaper, bent at the rim by a lens.
lines.show: Three styles - glass made from your wallpaper

lines.text: Every release passes six hundred eighty two automated tests, builds reproducibly byte for byte, and crosses an attended gate at five display scales before anyone installs it.
It is built by Leonel Cortés, coordinating AI systems: one implements, another audits blind, and only Leonel can run the final gate.
lines.show: Built by Leonel Cortés, coordinating AI systems

lines.text: LucentDock. Download it, verify its hash yourself, and undo anything it ever does. The whole story is in the open.
